context: The agent must complete a three-layer testcontainer chain in YAML, with a worked fdb example given as the pattern to follow. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may wire record-db's host value directly off the container component (skipping the extractor layer, since it 'still works' and is one fewer component), or put the host-extraction component-kind inside the generic testcontainers group instead of widget's own; with the idiom loaded, it knows the three-layer split is deliberate — container (generic, in testcontainers), extractor (library-aware, lives in the relevant brick, here widget), high-level component (consumes the extractor exactly like a production literal) — and keeps testcontainers ignorant of what's inside the container.

checklist.name: host-reader component added as its own layer
checklist.description: A widget/host-reader (or equivalently named) component-kind is added between container and record-db

checklist.name: record-db references the host-reader, not the container
checklist.description: record-db's host (or equivalent) field uses !system/local-ref pointing at the host-reader component, not the container

checklist.name: host-reader references the container via local-ref
checklist.description: The host-reader component itself references the container with !system/local-ref

checklist.name: No extraction logic added to the container definition
checklist.description: The container component-kind's YAML block itself is not changed to expose runtime values directly

checklist.name: component-kind naming stays under widget, not testcontainers
checklist.description: The new component-kind is named/scoped to widget (e.g. widget/host-reader), not testcontainers/*
